candidates.description: This feature vector activates on various types of quotation marks, punctuation, and enclosing symbols.
This feature vector represents French copula and auxiliary verbs across various tenses and moods.
This feature vector represents abbreviations, prefixes, and terms related to saints, holy figures, and proper names associated with them.
These tokens represent East Asian logographic and phonetic characters from Chinese, Japanese, and Korean writing systems.
These tokens represent various combinations of closing punctuation marks, particularly parentheses, quotation marks, and terminal punctuation used at the end of sentences or clauses.
This vector activates for common French grammatical words, pronouns, and articles.
This vector activates for French first- and second-person pronouns, determiners, and words containing the nasal /n/ or /v/ sounds.
This vector is related to French personal pronouns.
This vector represents the dichotomy and historical evolution between traditional, conventional, and modern cultural or religious practices.
The tokens represent Roman numerals and related ordinal or numerical concepts across different cases and representations.
